It offers no recommendation, no discussion of the tri-state design, no soundness argument, no architecture, no telemetry plan, and no scope calibration. Against the settled outcome (tri-state member-visibility policy with continue-only-if-all-Hidden and the buy-sizing caveat), the memo matches nothing because it says nothing substantive.
verdict.rationale: There is no content to grade against the settled outcome's shape or caveats. This is a non-answer/status update, not a design memo, so every grading dimension fails by default: no recommendation was made, no load-bearing caveats were carried, no scope was proposed, and following this memo would leave the team with zero guidance, preventing none of the missteps the vindication record implies were avoided by the actual tri-state design.
